title: Validation Record Storage
description: Append-only persistence of every validation run (skill or tool) with verdict, metrics, and version pinning at run time. Forms the basis for trend analysis and convergence tracking.

requirements.title: ValidationRecord schema + writer
requirements.description: SQLite schema: id, tuple_kind (skill|tool), subject_id (skill_id or tool_id), golden_id, agent_manager_run_id (nullable, for skill runs), started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, tokens_used (nullable, for skill runs), cost_estimate (nullable), verdict, diff_hash (nullable), manifest_template_version_at_run, manifest_skill_version_at_run, raw_output_ref. Insert-only.

requirements.title: Query API
requirements.description: Repository queries: latest record per (subject, golden) tuple; full chronological history per tuple; aggregate counts per verdict per skill/tool per golden.
